content.title: Michigan Wolverines vs St. Louis: How to watch today’s March Madness game for free
content.text: Updated: Mar. 21, 2026, 7:06 a.m.Published: Mar. 21, 2026, 6:55 a.m.Michigan Wolverines forward Morez Johnson Jr. (21) moves the ball as Michigan faces Howard in the first round of the NCAA basketball tournament in Buffalo, New York on Thursday, March 19 2026.Jacob Hamilton | MLive.comIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By John Holland | The Oregonian/OregonLiveThe No. 9 Saint Louis Billikens face the No. 1 Michigan Wolverines today in an exciting second-round showdown. Michigan pulled away late to defeat Howard in the opening round, while the Billikens advanced after destroying the Georgia Bulldogs 102-77.
